text:
adeep: Seeing elevated errors and long tails from us-west2b GPU pool starting ~17:05 UTC. Mostly egress connection resets and gRPC timeouts. ~10% of nodes reporting steady 'connection reset by peer' and model snippets failing with 503s.

ops-bot: incident created: #INC-2026-1890123456 - us-west2b partial az network degradation :rotating_light:

kai: what's the impact? latency, errors, or full node flaps?

maria: Grafana panels -> https://grafana.internal/board/infra/az-tilt show p95 token latency jump from 80ms -> 520ms, error rate on /v1/generate up 2.3% overall but 7-9% for requests routed to us-west2b.

linh: recommendation: slow drain non-critical GPU instances first (batch-only workloads), shift routing weights 10% at a time to other AZs, and warm caches in target AZ. Avoid full evacuation unless errors keep rising.

adeep: +1. Plan I'm going to: 1) cordon gpunodepool-uw2b-noncritical 2) start draining pods with graceful timeout 5m 3) scale up gpunodepool-uw2a/usw2c by +3 nodes each 4) adjust router weights every 12m by 10%.

adeep: commands I'll run:
```
kubectl cordon nodepool/gpunodepool-uw2b-noncritical
kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=300 node/<node-name>
# terraform apply -target=module.nodepools.usw2a.capacity=+3
```

sre-rotations: make sure to disable aggressive batching on the edge for the duration to prevent head-of-line blocking. Also enable fallback to quantized model variant for non-SLA routes (enable flag: infra.fallback.quantized=true).

kai: note on cost: extra nodes will add ~ $1.4k/day if we spin up 6 GPUs across AZs; tradeoff is reduced error budget. Approve spin-up if errors >5% sustained for 10m.

maria: I'll flip the dev/test traffic flag to redirect non-prod to the cold pool and pre-warm caches in target AZs. Also will run small canary A/B to confirm KV hit rates before moving user traffic.

linh: I pushed a small script to orchestrate weight shifts: https://git.internal/reorg/az-shift. We'll run it with --step 10 --interval 12m. I'll own it and monitor.

adeep: initiating cordon/drain on 3 nodes now. Posting updates here every 10m. If error rate climbs >10% or p95 >1s, we escalate to full evacuation.

kai: ack. I'll watch SLO alerts and take cost approval if capacity grows beyond projected.

maria: pre-warm job started. PV warm rate at 60% in target AZs.

adeep: first 3 nodes drained successfully, router weight shifted 10% off us-west2b. Observability: p95 down to 320ms, errors down to 4.1%.

linh: continuing to monitor. Keep notes in incident doc: https://docs.internal/incidents/1890123456

adeep: next shift scheduled in 12m.
